parameters.name: AccountIds
parameters.description: The list of Alibaba Cloud accounts with which to share the template. A maximum of five accounts can be specified at a time.

parameters.name: IsFavorite
parameters.description: Specifies whether to add the template to or remove it from favorites.

parameters.name: SharePermissionAction
parameters.description: The action to perform on the shared template.

parameters.name: ShareTemplateVersion
parameters.description: The version of the shared template.
